children: Australia’s Ai Group Industry Index for manufacturing eased further into contraction in August, rising to -16.6 from July’s upwardly revised -19.3.
The latest reading highlighted that the contraction in manufacturing sectors eased in August, although both remained firmly negative.
The sector remained under pressure as lower domestic demand, rising input costs, heavier compliance burdens, supply chain challenges, and stronger competition from imports squeezed margins.

title: Australia Manufacturing Contraction Eases
